name: MoveMouse
label: Move Mouse
description: Moves the mouse cursor to a specific position on the screen.

fields.name: PositionX
fields.label: Position X
fields.description: Specifies the X coordinate on the screen where the mouse should be moved.

fields.name: PositionY
fields.label: Position Y
fields.description: Specifies the Y coordinate on the screen where the mouse should be moved.

fields.name: RelativeTo
fields.label: Relative To
fields.description: Determines the reference point for the mouse movement. Can be relative to the screen or a specific window.

fields.name: MoveMouseFromPreviousPosition
fields.label: Move Mouse From Previous Position
fields.description: Specifies whether to move the mouse from its current location using an animated effect, and sets the speed of the animation.

selectOptions.label: Low Speed
selectOptions.description: Animation runs at a slow speed.

selectOptions.label: High Speed
selectOptions.description: Animation runs at a fast speed.

fields.name: CurrentCursorPosition
fields.label: Current Cursor Position
fields.description: Returns the cursor's final position on the screen after the mouse operation completes.
